column1: Competency,Description,Example Roles,Explanation

Action Oriented,"Proactively takes initiative and addresses challenges with energy and urgency.","Corporate Project Manager; Operations Specialist (I/II/III); K–12 Principal; Classroom Teacher","In business, roles like a project manager or operations specialist must drive projects forward despite obstacles. In K–12, principals and teachers often respond to urgent issues immediately. Specialist or Coordinator roles (e.g., Instructional Specialist I/II/III) are expected to quickly implement changes."

Attracts Top Talent,"Draws and selects the best candidates to build high-performing teams.","Corporate HR Recruiter; Talent Acquisition Manager; K–12 Principal; School HR Coordinator","Companies compete for skilled workers using creative recruiting methods. In K–12, principals or district HR coordinators attract excellent teachers and staff. This applies from entry-level Specialists to Manager-level roles."

Balances Stakeholders,"Considers and integrates diverse interests to reach fair, practical solutions.","Corporate Project Manager; Client Relations Analyst; K–12 Superintendent; School Board Liaison","Project managers and client relations roles balance customer, partner, and team needs. In K–12, superintendents and principals reconcile teacher, parent, and board priorities. Analyst or Coordinator roles support this balance by synthesizing feedback."

Being Resilient,"Recovers quickly from setbacks and adapts to challenges.","Operations Manager; Customer Service Specialist; K–12 Teacher; School Counselor","Business roles and K–12 educators both face daily challenges. The ability to bounce back is crucial whether handling a project setback or a difficult classroom day. This applies across levels—from Specialists to Managers."

Builds Effective Teams,"Creates cohesive teams that leverage diverse skills to achieve shared goals.","Corporate Team Leader; Project Manager; K–12 Principal; Department Chair","Team leaders and principals foster collaboration by aligning diverse skills toward common objectives. Manager and Coordinator roles ensure team efforts are synchronized at every level."

Builds Networks,"Develops a broad range of professional relationships to share knowledge and support goals.","Business Development Manager; Sales Coordinator; K–12 Career Counselor; Community Engagement Specialist","Networking is vital in securing partnerships in business and expanding opportunities in education. This competency is critical for roles from entry-level Coordinators to senior Managers."

Business Insight,"Uses commercial and market understanding to make informed decisions.","Corporate Strategy Analyst; Business Consultant; K–12 District CFO; School Business Manager","A strong grasp of market forces is vital for profitability in business and managing tight budgets in schools. From Analysts to Managers, this insight informs strategic decisions."

Collaborates,"Works effectively with others to achieve common objectives.","Team Coordinator; Cross-Functional Project Manager; K–12 Teaching Team; Instructional Coach","Collaboration drives success whether in cross-functional teams in business or collaborative teaching teams in schools. It is essential for all levels, including Specialist and Manager roles."

Communicates Effectively,"Conveys information clearly and tailors messages to the audience.","Corporate Communications Specialist; Marketing Analyst; K–12 Teacher; Principal","Clear communication is essential to avoid misunderstandings. In business and K–12 settings, roles from Coordinators to Leaders adjust their messaging to fit the audience."

Courage,"Addresses tough issues openly and stands up for what is right despite risks.","Change Manager; Business Consultant; K–12 Principal; Lead Teacher","Change managers and consultants challenge the status quo, while school leaders address unpopular issues for student benefit. This is essential from entry-level to senior roles."

Cultivates Innovation,"Fosters creative thinking and the development of new approaches.","R&D Manager; Product Development Specialist; K–12 STEM Coordinator; Innovative Teacher","Innovation drives competitive advantage. In business, R&D and product roles push boundaries; in K–12, STEM coordinators introduce new teaching methods. This is key for Analyst, Tech, and Specialist roles."

Customer Focus,"Prioritizes customer (or student/family) needs in all decisions.","Customer Service Manager; Account Manager; K–12 Teacher; School Administrator","Meeting the needs of customers or students is paramount. In both sectors, roles ensure high standards of service from entry-level Specialists to Managers."

Decision Quality,"Makes sound, timely decisions based on analysis and judgment.","Operations Analyst; Business Manager; K–12 Superintendent; Department Chair","Timely, high-quality decisions drive results. This is critical for roles at every level—from entry-level Analysts to senior Managers—ensuring that decisions lead to success."

Demonstrates Self-Awareness,"Recognizes personal strengths and limitations, seeking feedback for improvement.","Professional Development Coach; HR Specialist; K–12 Teacher; School Leader","Self-awareness fosters growth in any role. In both business and education, this trait underpins continuous improvement from Specialists to Managers."

Develops Talent,"Helps others grow professionally and reach their full potential.","Learning & Development Manager; Training Specialist; K–12 Principal; Instructional Coach","Nurturing talent leads to stronger teams. Roles that focus on training and mentoring in business and education support career growth at every level."

Directs Work,"Provides clear guidance and removes obstacles to ensure tasks are completed.","Project Manager; Operations Supervisor; K–12 Principal; Department Chair","Clear direction and delegation are key to successful execution. This applies to roles in both business and education, from entry-level Specialists to senior Managers."

Drives Engagement,"Creates an environment where people feel motivated to contribute their best.","Employee Engagement Specialist; Team Leader; K–12 Principal; School Culture Coordinator","Engaged teams are more productive. Whether in a corporate setting or a school, leaders at all levels foster an environment where people feel valued."

Drives Results,"Consistently achieves goals through persistent focus and execution.","Operations Manager; Sales Manager; K–12 Superintendent; Department Chair","Results-driven roles meet targets despite obstacles. This competency is demonstrated by everyone—from entry-level Specialists to senior Managers—through a commitment to achieving objectives."

Drives Vision and Purpose,"Inspires others with a clear, compelling vision and sense of mission.","Corporate Visionary/CEO; Strategic Consultant; K–12 Principal; School Leader","Visionary leaders rally teams around a common purpose. In business and K–12 education, leaders articulate a future that motivates others, a skill valuable at all levels."

Ensures Accountability,"Holds self and others responsible for meeting commitments and standards.","Operations Manager; Quality Assurance Specialist; K–12 Principal; Department Chair","Accountability ensures that tasks are completed and standards maintained. This is critical in every role—from entry-level Specialists to senior Managers—because it builds trust and drives performance."

Financial Acumen,"Uses financial data and analysis to inform strategic decisions.","Financial Analyst; Business Manager; School Business Manager; District CFO","Financial insight is essential for sustainable decision-making. Analysts and Managers alike use data to optimize budgets and drive efficiency."

Global Perspective,"Considers international trends and diverse cultural contexts in decision-making.","Global Marketing Analyst; Business Consultant; International Studies Coordinator; Curriculum Developer","A global perspective allows organizations to adapt in a connected world. This insight benefits roles from Analysts to senior Managers and enriches K–12 curricula."

Instills Trust,"Gains confidence and credibility through integrity and consistency.","HR Manager; Customer Relations Specialist; K–12 Principal; Lead Teacher","Trust is foundational. Whether in business or education, consistent and ethical behavior by specialists and leaders alike builds long-term credibility."

Interpersonal Savvy,"Relates comfortably with diverse groups, adapting style to different audiences.","Client Relationship Manager; Team Leader; K–12 Teacher; School Counselor","Effective interpersonal skills help navigate diverse relationships. Roles from Coordinators to Managers adjust their style to connect with different groups, enhancing collaboration."

Manages Ambiguity,"Operates effectively when information or outcomes are uncertain.","Strategy Analyst; Business Consultant; Instructional Coach; Department Chair","Dealing with incomplete information is common. Analysts and Consultants, as well as educators, must make decisions in uncertain conditions, a critical skill at all levels."

Manages Complexity,"Makes sense of multifaceted information to solve problems.","Data Analyst; Operations Manager; Department Chair; Curriculum Coordinator","Breaking down complex data is essential in both business and education. This competency is key for roles that require analytical thinking—from Analysts to senior Managers."

Manages Conflict,"Effectively addresses and resolves disputes with minimal disruption.","Mediator/Conflict Resolution Specialist; HR Specialist; K–12 Principal; School Counselor","Conflict management prevents disruption. In business and schools, roles that resolve disputes maintain a productive environment, a skill valued across all levels."

Nimble Learning,"Quickly learns from experience and adapts approaches accordingly.","Business Analyst; Innovation Specialist; K–12 Teacher; Professional Development Coordinator","Continuous learning is crucial in fast-changing environments. Whether in corporate roles or in the classroom, quick learners improve outcomes and adapt strategies."

Optimizes Work Processes,"Streamlines procedures to improve efficiency and outcomes.","Process Improvement Manager; Operations Analyst; School Business Manager; Administrative Coordinator","Optimizing workflows reduces waste and increases productivity. This applies to roles from entry-level Specialists to Managers in both business and education."

Organizational Savvy,"Navigates internal dynamics and unwritten rules to get things done.","Organizational Development Specialist; Management Consultant; K–12 Principal; Department Chair","Understanding an organization’s culture is key to effective leadership. Whether in business or a school setting, this savvy enables leaders to build alliances and move initiatives forward."

Persuades,"Uses compelling arguments to gain commitment and support from others.","Sales Manager; Marketing Specialist; K–12 Principal; Lead Teacher","Persuasion is critical to secure buy-in. From selling ideas in business to advocating changes in schools, effective persuasion is essential for success at all levels."

Plans and Aligns,"Sets clear priorities and aligns actions with strategic goals.","Project Manager; Strategic Planner; K–12 Principal; Department Chair","Good planning turns goals into actionable steps. Whether in corporate projects or school improvement plans, aligning daily work with strategy is vital from Specialists to Managers."

Resourcefulness,"Finds creative ways to solve problems when resources are limited.","Operations Specialist; Customer Support Specialist; K–12 Teacher; Instructional Specialist (I/II/III)","Resourcefulness means achieving goals even with limited resources. In both business and education, creative problem-solving is prized at every level."

Self-Development,"Actively pursues personal and professional growth opportunities.","Learning & Development Specialist; Business Analyst; K–12 Teacher; Instructional Coach","Continuous self-improvement drives growth. Roles from entry-level Specialists to senior Managers benefit by constantly acquiring new skills and knowledge."

Situational Adaptability,"Adjusts behavior and strategies according to evolving circumstances.","Customer Service Manager; Project Leader; K–12 Teacher; School Counselor","Adapting to changing situations is crucial. In both sectors, effective leaders and team members adjust their approaches based on context, ensuring success under diverse conditions."

Strategic Mindset,"Envisions long-term opportunities and formulates plans to achieve them.","Corporate Strategist; Business Consultant; K–12 Superintendent; Curriculum Director","Strategic thinking enables proactive planning. From Analysts to Managers, the ability to see the long-term picture is essential for guiding organizations toward future success."

Tech Savvy,"Embraces and leverages new digital tools to drive efficiency and innovation.","IT Specialist; Digital Marketing Coordinator; K–12 EdTech Coordinator; Instructional Technologist","Staying current with technology is vital. Whether integrating new software in business or digital tools in classrooms, tech-savvy professionals lead digital transformation."

Values Differences,"Appreciates and leverages diverse perspectives and backgrounds.","Diversity & Inclusion Specialist; HR Specialist; K–12 Teacher; School Counselor","Embracing diversity enhances creativity and fairness. From corporate D&I specialists to educators integrating multicultural perspectives, this competency builds inclusive environments."
